newsitem.title: INDIA: India Bajaj Auto 96/97 sales at 1.42 mln units.
newsitem.headline: India Bajaj Auto 96/97 sales at 1.42 mln units.

text.p: Sales of Indian scooter giant Bajaj Auto Ltd rose to 1,422,849 units in the year ended March 31, 1997, from 1,307,211 units a year ago, the company said on Wednesday.
Production rose to 1,439,174 units from 1,302,031 units, the firm said after finalising results for 1996/97.
Net profit rose to 4.40 billion rupees from 4.18 billion in 1995/96 on higher sales of 34.54 billion rupees against 27.9 billion.
The directors recommended unchanged dividend of 10 rupees per share of 10-rupees face value.
The company said its board will meet on May 19 to consider a bonus equity issue.
